message.content:
Implement the "Beef up Invoices" feature in the Nxeon platform at /opt/nxeon (Next.js App Router + Prisma/Postgres). The board card asks for "more info on invoices like payment method for example." Add the payment method + richer detail to invoices. Verify with `cd /opt/nxeon && npx prisma generate` then `npx tsc --noEmit` (exit 0) and `npx tsx --test test/customer-actions-guards.test.ts` (stay green). Do NOT run `prisma db push`, do NOT build, deploy, or commit — I will run the DB push and build after reviewing. Report files changed + the exact new schema fields.

## Data facts (already confirmed)
- `Invoice` model has: number, userId, amountCents, taxCents, status (InvoiceStatus OPEN/PAID/VOID/REFUNDED), refundedCents, description, lineItems (Json [{description,qty,unitCents,amountCents}]), periodStart, periodEnd, paidAt, createdAt. NO payment-method fields yet.
- The paying card is the user's saved card: `User.cardBrand`, `User.cardLast4`, `User.stripePaymentMethodId`.
- Invoices are marked PAID at THREE sites: `lib/actions-billing.ts:~77` (manual mark-paid), `worker/billing.ts:~522` and `~1571` (auto-charge via `chargeSavedCardOffSession`). Migrations use `prisma db push` (additive nullable fields are safe).

## 1. Schema — snapshot the card used, at payment time
Add to the `Invoice` model (nullable, additive — safe for db push):
```
paidBrand  String?   // card brand snapshot at time this invoice was paid (e.g. "visa")
paidLast4  String?   // card last4 snapshot at time paid
```
Run `npx prisma generate` after editing schema so the client + tsc see the new fields. (Do NOT run db push.)

## 2. Snapshot at each PAID transition
At ALL THREE places an invoice becomes PAID, also set `paidBrand`/`paidLast4` from the user's current `cardBrand`/`cardLast4` (the card that was just charged). 
- `lib/actions-billing.ts:~77` (`markInvoicePaid`-style): read the invoice's user's cardBrand/cardLast4 and include them in the same `invoice.update` that sets status PAID + paidAt.
- `worker/billing.ts:~522` and `~1571`: these charge `chargeSavedCardOffSession` for a user whose cardBrand/cardLast4 are known in scope (or fetch them) — set paidBrand/paidLast4 in the same update that sets status PAID. Use the card that was actually charged.
Keep it null-safe (a user with no saved card → leave null).

## 3. Surface the richer info in the UI
Enhance the customer + admin invoice views to show more than amount+status. Files: `components/customer/InvoiceViews.tsx`, `app/dashboard/invoices/page.tsx`, `app/dashboard/invoices/[id]/page.tsx`, `components/admin/InvoiceAdmin.tsx`, `app/admin/invoices/[id]/page.tsx`. Add (match existing styling / the Nxeon dark theme — reuse the components already there):
- **Payment method**: for a PAID invoice show "Paid with {Brand} •••• {last4} on {paidAt date}". Use `invoice.paidBrand`/`paidLast4`; FALL BACK to the user's current `cardBrand`/`cardLast4` for historical invoices that predate the snapshot (label it the same). If none known, show "Paid" without a card. For OPEN show "Awaiting payment"; VOID/REFUNDED show their state + refundedCents.
- **Amount breakdown**: subtotal (amountCents − taxCents), tax (taxCents), total, and refunded amount if refundedCents>0 — all formatted as currency.
- **Billing period**: periodStart–periodEnd when present.
- **Line items**: render the `lineItems` Json as a small table (description, qty, unit, amount) if not already shown.
Make sure any server component/query that renders these SELECTs the new fields and the user's card fields (or the whole invoice + user). Keep queries owner-scoped (a customer only sees their own invoices — preserve existing auth/ownership checks).

## Constraints
- Additive + backward compatible: existing invoices (null paidBrand) render fine via the fallback. No behavior change to charging logic beyond writing the snapshot.
- Currency formatting: reuse whatever helper the codebase already uses for cents→display (grep for an existing `formatCents`/`money`/`toFixed(2)` pattern; don't invent a new convention).
- Server actions keep their auth markers (guard test `test/customer-actions-guards.test.ts` must stay green).
- Finish only when `prisma generate` + `tsc --noEmit` are clean and the guard test passes. Report the new schema fields, the three snapshot edits, and every UI file changed.

All three verification steps pass cleanly. Here's the summary.

## Done — "Beef up Invoices"

**New schema fields** (added to `model Invoice` in `/opt/nxeon/prisma/schema.prisma`, both nullable/additive — safe for `db push`):
```prisma
paidBrand  String?   // card brand snapshot at time paid (e.g. "visa")
paidLast4  String?   // card last4 snapshot at time paid
```

**Three PAID-transition snapshot edits** (each null-safe — wallet-only users leave the fields null):
1. `/opt/nxeon/lib/actions-billing.ts` — `markInvoicePaid`: the `findUnique` now `include`s the owner's `cardBrand`/`cardLast4`, and the `invoice.update` that sets `status: PAID` + `paidAt` also writes `paidBrand`/`paidLast4`.
2. `/opt/nxeon/worker/billing.ts` — VPS renewal (`commitRenewal`, ~522): passes `paidBrand`/`paidLast4` from `server.user.cardBrand/cardLast4` into `invoiceCreateData`.
3. `/opt/nxeon/worker/billing.ts` — domain auto-renewal (`domainAutoRenewSweep`, ~1571): passes them from `domain.user.cardBrand/cardLast4`.

**Supporting lib changes** — `/opt/nxeon/lib/invoices.ts`:
- Extended `InvoiceInput` + `invoiceCreateData` with optional `paidBrand`/`paidLast4` (only stamped when the invoice is born `PAID`, mirroring `paidAt`).
- Added `invoicePaymentMethod(invoice, fallbackCard?)` helper — reuses existing `brandLabel` (from `lib/stripe-cards.ts`) and the module's `fmtDate`. Renders "Paid with {Brand} •••• {last4} on {date}" for PAID/REFUNDED, falling back to the user's current card for pre-snapshot invoices; "Awaiting payment" for OPEN; "Void" for VOID; plain "Paid …" when no card is known.
- `renderInvoiceHTML` (downloadable doc) now prints the card snapshot line when present.

**UI files changed:**
- `/opt/nxeon/app/dashboard/invoices/[id]/page.tsx` — added a "Payment method" cell (uses `invoicePaymentMethod(invoice, user)`) and a "Refunded" total row when `refundedCents > 0`.
- `/opt/nxeon/app/dashboard/invoices/page.tsx` — added a compact "Method" column (brand ···· last4, with current-card fallback) to the list.
- `/opt/nxeon/app/admin/invoices/[id]/page.tsx` — added `cardBrand`/`cardLast4` to the `user` select (for fallback), a "Payment method" cell, and a "Refunded" total row.

I left `components/admin/InvoiceAdmin.tsx` and `components/customer/InvoiceViews.tsx` untouched — they hold only action buttons / the status badge, and the richer detail is composed in the pages themselves.

Ownership/auth preserved: the customer detail page keeps its `invoice.userId !== user.id → notFound()` check, the admin page keeps `requireArea("billing")`, and all queries stay owner-scoped.
